segments.sn41.2:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū macchikāsaṇḍe viharanti ambāṭakavane.
segments.sn41.2:1.2: Atha kho citto gahapati yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho citto gahapati there bhikkhū etadavoca –
segments.sn41.2:1.5: Atha kho citto gahapati therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
segments.sn41.2:1.6: Atha kho therā bhikkhū tassā rattiyā accayena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena cittassa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃsu.
segments.sn41.2:2.1: Atha kho citto gahapati yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn41.2:2.3: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā”ti?
segments.sn41.2:2.4: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā thero tuṇhī ahosi.
segments.sn41.2:2.5: Dutiyampi kho citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn41.2:2.7: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā”ti?
segments.sn41.2:2.8: Dutiyampi kho āyasmā thero tuṇhī ahosi.
segments.sn41.2:2.9: Tatiyampi kho citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn41.2:2.11: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā”ti?
segments.sn41.2:2.12: Tatiyampi kho āyasmā thero tuṇhī ahosi.
segments.sn41.2:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā isidatto tasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sabbanavako hoti.
segments.sn41.2:3.2: Atha kho āyasmā isidatto āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn41.2:3.3: “byākaromahaṃ, bhante thera, cittassa gahapatino etaṃ pañhan”ti?
segments.sn41.2:3.4: “Byākarohi tvaṃ, āvuso isidatta, cittassa gahapatino etaṃ pañhan”ti.
segments.sn41.2:3.7: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, dhātunānattaṃ, vuttaṃ bhagavatā’”ti?
segments.sn41.2:3.12: Ettāvatā kho, gahapati, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā”ti.
segments.sn41.2:4.1: Atha kho citto gahapati āyasmato isidattassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā there bhikkhū paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
segments.sn41.2:4.2: Atha kho therā bhikkhū bhuttāvino onītapattapāṇino uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
segments.sn41.2:4.3: Atha kho āyasmā thero āyasmantaṃ isidattaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn41.2:4.4: “sādhu kho taṃ, āvuso isidatta, eso pañho paṭibhāsi, neso pañho maṃ paṭibhāsi.
segments.sn41.2:4.5: Tenahāvuso isidatta, yadā aññathāpi [yadā aññadāpi (sī. pī.) aññadāpi (?)] evarūpo pañho āgaccheyya, taññevettha paṭibhāseyyā”ti.

lines: Dutiye āyasmantaṃ theranti tesu theresu jeṭṭhakaṃ mahātheraṃ.
Tuṇhī ahosīti jānantopi avisāradattā na kiñci byāhari.

Byākaromahaṃ bhanteti “ayaṃ thero neva attanā byākaroti, na aññe ajjhesati, upāsakopi bhikkhusaṅghaṃ viheseti, ahametaṃ byākaritvā phāsuvihāraṃ katvā dassāmī”ti cintetvā āsanato vuṭṭhāya therassa santikaṃ gantvā evaṃ okāsamakāsi, katāvakāso pana attano āsane nisīditvā byākāsi.
Sampavāresīti “alaṃ alan”ti hatthasaññāya ceva vācāya ca paṭikkhipāpesi.
Onītapattapāṇinoti pāṇito apanītapattā dhovitvā thavikāya osāpetvā aṃse laggitapattāti attho.
Upāsako theresu byākātuṃ asakkontesu sayaṃ byākātukāmo pucchati, na vihesādhippāyo.
Paṭhamavacanena abyākaronte disvāva punappunaṃ pucchitaṃ viheso viya hotīti katvā vuttaṃ “vihesetī”ti.
